items.title: Add explicit authority_enforce_runner once/dry-run command
items.context: Add a supported command namespace that requires explicit invocation and never runs during normal local story commands. It should resolve authority settings, actor key, runner ID/session, register/heartbeat runner, and claim at most one job in once mode.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `lattice authority enforce runner --once --dry-run --json` 看到 planned register/heartbeat/claim steps and `spawned:false`/no provider execution in dry-run.

happy.desc: Dry-run runner command projects register/heartbeat/claim steps without network mutation or provider execution.

edge.desc: Missing URL/actor key in enforce runner mode fails with actionable error while local lifecycle commands remain usable.

adversarial.desc: Runner command cannot be invoked implicitly by verification_evidence_add or story_advance.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers dry-run runner command: asserts schema lattice.authority_enforce_runner.v1, planned register/heartbeat/claim steps, spawned=false, providerEvents=[], and nested lattice authority enforce runner alias returns JSON.
Covers missing enforce settings: same smoke asserts missing URL/actor key/runner ID returns status=fail while localWorkflowUsable remains true and no provider events are produced.

verificationEvidence.command: npm run test:authority-enforce-runner && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lifecycle-registry-contract && npm run test:command-ownership-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Covers non-implicit command boundary: ordinary authority_status has no plannedSteps, authority_enforce_runner is explicitly registered as readOnly/L0 with lifecycle and ownership contract coverage, and cannot become an unclassified implicit story command.

items.title: Execute claimed fake-provider jobs and emit signed provider events
items.context: For tests and controlled headless mode, support fake/local command execution from JobSpec commandPreview/permissions; hash stdout/stderr transcript; send stdout/stderr/completed/failed provider events signed by runner actor key.
items.userSees: Smoke transcript shows provider events: stdout_delta, completed with exitCode 0 and transcriptHash; failed command produces failed event and non-zero runner result.

happy.desc: Claimed allowed fake job emits stdout_delta and completed provider events with transcript hash.

edge.desc: Non-zero command emits failed provider event and releases/marks job according to contract.

adversarial.desc: Unleased or mismatched provider/run IDs are rejected by fake server/client tests before evidence submission.

verificationEvidence.note: Covers allowed fake-provider job: executeFakeProviderJob emits stdout_delta and completed events with exitCode 0, transcriptHash, signed ProviderEventsEnvelope, and envelope verification succeeds.
Covers non-zero fake-provider job: stderr is captured, failed event is emitted with exitCode 7 and transcriptHash, and the signed envelope verifies.
Covers adversarial claim boundaries: runnerId mismatch, expected runId mismatch, and provider other than fake-provider are rejected before event/evidence submission.
